sehemu: Part II: High Court of the United Republic
jina: Tenure of office of Judges of the High Court
maudhui: (1) Every Judge of the High Court shall vacate office on attaining the age of sixty years, subject to the following provisions of this Article. (2) A Judge of the High Court may retire from service in the Government of the United Republic at any time after attaining the age of fifty-five years, unless the President directs that the Judge shall not retire, in which case the Judge shall not be entitled to retire until the period specified by the President has expired. (3) Where the President considers it to be in the public interest for a Judge who has attained the age of sixty years to continue in office, and the Judge agrees in writing to continue in office, the President may direct that the Judge continue in office for such period as the President may specify. (4) Notwithstanding that a Judge has attained the age at which he is required to vacate office under this Article, a person holding office as a Judge of the High Court may continue in office after attaining that age until he has completed preparing and delivering judgment or completed any other proceedings connected with matters which he had already begun to hear.
vifungu: (1) Every Judge of the High Court shall vacate office on attaining the age of sixty years, subject to the following provisions of this Article.

(2) A Judge of the High Court may retire from service in the Government of the United Republic at any time after attaining the age of fifty-five years, unless the President directs that the Judge shall not retire, in which case the Judge shall not be entitled to retire until the period specified by the President has expired.

(3) Where the President considers it to be in the public interest for a Judge who has attained the age of sixty years to continue in office, and the Judge agrees in writing to continue in office, the President may direct that the Judge continue in office for such period as the President may specify.

(4) Notwithstanding that a Judge has attained the age at which he is required to vacate office under this Article, a person holding office as a Judge of the High Court may continue in office after attaining that age until he has completed preparing and delivering judgment or completed any other proceedings connected with matters which he had already begun to hear.
